Rembrandt van Rijn (1606-1669), Dutch painter, draftsman, and printmaker

referred_to_by.content: Noted as one of the most popular and influential artists of his period. His work is characterized by the Baroque interest in dramatic scenes and strong contrasts of light on a dark stage. His works include paintings, etchings, and drawings of subjects including portraits, landscapes, figures, animals, biblical and secular history and mythology.
